rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an explanation or the meaning someone gives to something unclear.

example.english: The teacher's interpretation was very clear, so I finally understood it.
example.traditional: 老師嘅解釋好清楚，我終於明白喇。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 ge3 gaai2 sik1 hou2 cing1 co2 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 ming4 baak6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the translation or translated version sense, especially when converting between languages.

example.english: The interpretation of the document isn't finished yet.
example.traditional: 份文件嘅翻譯仲未完成。
example.jyutping: fan6 man4 gin6 ge3 faan1 jik6 zung6 mei6 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this specifically for interpreting spoken or signed language rather than translating written text.

example.english: The interpretation throughout the meeting was handled by professionals.
example.traditional: 會議全程都由專業人員負責口譯。
example.jyutping: wui6 ji5 cyun4 cing4 dou1 jau4 zyun1 jip6 jan4 jyun4 fu6 zaak3 hau2 jik6
